messages:
maria: Heads up — after the kernel-selector change rolled to canary, p95 for /chat-gen (prod tier) jumped ~40ms. Not huge but repeated across 3 nodes. :eyes:

maria: Quick correlates from profiling: KV cache miss rate up ~18% on those nodes, average microbatch formation time +12ms. Attaching snippets below.

kevin: Can you paste the logs/samples?

maria: log tail:
```
[2026-03-18T10:12:23Z] route=/chat-gen tier=prod req_id=... batch_id=442 kvcache_hit=false batch_wait_ms=18 kernel=optv2
[2026-03-18T10:12:23Z] route=/chat-gen tier=prod req_id=... batch_start_ms=7 p95_latency_ms=190
[2026-03-18T10:12:23Z] route=/chat-gen tier=prod req_id=... kvcache_insert_ms=3
```

maria: Small summary: kernel-selector moved these shards to the new attention kernel which slightly changed scheduling; KV page eviction patterns changed (more short-context misses). Batcher saw more micro-slices because token budgets were unchanged.

ali: Thanks — this smells like interaction between kernel latency variance + unchanged token_budget targets that allow bigger microbatches to form and then suffer cache churn.

ali: Proposal: introduce an SLO-driven dynamic token_budget_by_route/tier that tightens budgets for routes where p95 > target. Quick example config:
```json
{
  "route": "/chat-gen",
  "tier_policies": [
    {"tier": "enterprise", "token_budget": "80", "target_p95_ms": "140"},
    {"tier": "standard", "token_budget": "20", "target_p95_ms": "200"},
    {"tier": "free", "token_budget": "12", "target_p95_ms": "300"}
  ],
  "evaluation_window_s": "120",
  "adjust_step": "5"
}
```

jon: That config looks reasonable. We should also gate adjustments behind a stability window so we don't thrash (e.g., require 3 consecutive windows of breach).

stella: Agreed. Also add a max_backoff so token_budget doesn't drop below X for quality reasons. For chat-gen short contexts, dropping too low increases truncation.

maria: Notes: target_p95_ms corresponds to the route's SLA-derived p95. The controller will query /metrics p95 for route+tier; if current_p95 > target by >10% for N windows -> decrement token_budget by adjust_step until p95 within range or min_budget reached.

ali: Suggest we rollout as a canary on a few shards with both kernel versions to see interaction. Canary plan: 10% traffic on canary pool A (kernel old), 10% on pool B (kernel new) with dynamic-budget controller enabled only on pool B. Observe p95 delta over 30m.

maria: Canary command (k8s patch snippet):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: dynamic-budget-config-canary
data:
  routes: |
    - path: /chat-gen
      tiers:
        - name: standard
          token_budget: 20
          target_p95_ms: 200
      evaluation_window_s: 120
      consecutive_windows: 3
      adjust_step: 5
      min_budget: 12
```

infra-bot: deploy triggered: canary/dynamic-budget-config-canary -> pool-b-newkernel (10% traffic). Job id: jb-7841 :rocket:

perf-bot: Quick check scheduled: running 30m synthetic p95 run against /chat-gen (short/med/long contexts). Will post summary.

kevin: For observability, add these derived dims to the dashboards: route, tier, kernel_version, kvcache_hit_rate, batch_wait_ms_mean, microbatch_count_p95. We need correlates in the same panel.

ali: Also add a KPI: token_budget_changes_count per hour to detect thrashing.

perf-bot: 30m run complete (short context):
  baseline_pool_oldkernel p95=165ms, kvcache_hit=86%
  canary_pool_newkernel p95=205ms, kvcache_hit=69%
  dynamic-budget applied on canary after 6m -> token_budget reduced from 30->25->20 across 3 windows. After reduction canary p95 dropped to 178ms, kvcache_hit stabilized to 75%.

stella: That's a promising signal. Quality impact? Any customer-facing truncations?

perf-bot: Truncation metric (short contexts) rose from 0.2% -> 0.6% at min_budget=12 threshold not reached; with current min_budget=12 observed truncation 0.25% after adjustments.

maria: Decision: proceed with staged rollout but add safety knobs — consecutive_windows=3, min_budget=12, max_changes_per_hour=2. Observability: create alert if token_budget_changes_count > 5 or if p95 increases >15% after change.

jon: I'll add the controller flags and a small unit test for budget staleness.

kevin: I'll update dashboard panels and add a short runbook for SRE if budget controller misbehaves.

maria: Thanks all. Follow-up: check again after 6h and we can expand canary to 30% if metrics stable. :thumbsup:

stella: :raised_hands:

infra-bot: note: canary config applied to pool-b-newkernel (nodes: r3-14,r3-15).

perf-bot: uploaded full perf artifacts -> https://perf.internal/redwood/canaries/jb-7841/artifacts

maria: linking this thread into the rollout ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-1129

kevin: Ping me if the alert fires.

maria: Will do. End of thread.
